footer_text: CONFIDENTIAL - Quantal AI Internal Engineering Review

sections.text: 2 findings across 2 severity levels. One P0 critical release blocker (plaintext password storage). One P2 performance defect. No application code was changed during this review.

sections.title: [P0] User passwords stored as plaintext in PostgreSQL

fields.label: Evidence
fields.body: src/auth/user.service.ts:L88 - INSERT stores the plaintext password field directly. No hashing anywhere in the call chain.

fields.label: Blast radius
fields.body: All registered users. A single database read exposes all credentials in plaintext, immediately usable without cracking.

fields.label: Remediation
fields.body: Hash passwords with bcrypt (cost factor >= 12) before storage. Force reset on next login for existing accounts.

fields.label: Prompt for a coding agent
fields.body: In src/auth/user.service.ts and auth.service.ts, replace plaintext password storage and comparison with bcrypt (cost 12). Add regression tests covering successful login, rejected login, and that the stored password never equals the plaintext input.

fields.label: Smoke test
items: Happy path: register then login with correct credentials returns 200 with a valid session.
Regression path: SELECT password FROM users WHERE email=... must not equal the plaintext password used at registration.

sections.title: [P2] N+1 query pattern on /api/projects list endpoint

fields.label: Evidence
fields.body: src/projects/project.service.ts:L67-L81 - listProjects() calls UserService.findById() inside a loop over all results.

fields.label: Blast radius
fields.body: At 200 projects, 201 queries per request. Latency scales linearly with project count.

fields.label: Remediation
fields.body: Replace the in-loop lookup with a single JOIN on users, or batch-fetch owner ids with WHERE id = ANY($1).

fields.label: Smoke test
items: GET /api/projects?page=1&limit=50 responds in under 200ms with owner data embedded.
Query log confirms exactly 1 SQL query issued, not 51.
